package.name: rog_planner
package.description: ROG-Map-aware 3-D planner for the sentry navigation stack (Phase 3). Front-end: 3-D voxel A* on ROG-Map's inflated occupancy. Back-end: uniform B-spline + L-BFGS smoothing with ESDF gradient. Tracker: 100 Hz cmd_vel publisher in virtual_frame, MCU-bridge compatible. Drop-in alternative to dstarlite via launch arg.
